content_html:
dora is a tiny, modular LLM agent kernel for Go. Its core is one loop and two interfaces: Model and Tool.

By default the CLI exposes only the Bash tool on macOS/Linux or the PowerShell tool on Windows; when skill directories are present, the skill tool is activated automatically, and there are no other tools. The CLI never injects a system prompt, sending only the user's prompt as a user message. No configuration file is required: setting a single provider API key environment variable (OpenAI, DeepSeek, or Trustoken) lets dora auto-select that provider and run immediately.

See docs/architecture.md for module boundaries, dependencies, interfaces, and runtime flows.

model := newMyModel()
weather := newWeatherTool()

agent, err := dora.New(model, weather)
if err != nil {
	log.Fatal(err)
}

result, err := agent.Run(ctx, []dora.Message{
	{Role: dora.RoleUser, Content: "What's the weather?"},
})
if err != nil {
	log.Fatal(err)
}

fmt.Println(result.Content)

The agent is stateless. Keep result.Messages and pass them to a later call to continue a conversation.

DoraBar is a companion macOS tray/menu-bar app for dora, written in Swift. It provides a lightweight menu-bar interface for interacting with the dora CLI.

Scope

The kernel supports optional model streaming events while keeping its baseline Model interface synchronous. Tool calls are deliberately executed only after the current model response completes, and are still sequential. There is no built-in memory, policy engine, middleware, or provider SDK.

CLI

Install

On macOS or Linux, install the latest release with curl:

curl -LsSf https://github.com/lgxz/dora/releases/latest/download/dora-installer.sh | sh

Use wget when curl is unavailable:

wget -qO- https://github.com/lgxz/dora/releases/latest/download/dora-installer.sh | sh

On Windows, use PowerShell:

powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -c "irm https://github.com/lgxz/dora/releases/latest/download/dora-installer.ps1 | iex"

The installers download the archive for the current OS and architecture, verify it against the release SHA-256 checksums, and install dora into $HOME/.local/bin by default. Set DORA_INSTALL_DIR to choose another directory:

curl -LsSf https://github.com/lgxz/dora/releases/latest/download/dora-installer.sh \
  | env DORA_INSTALL_DIR=/usr/local/bin sh

Install a specific release by using its tagged installer URL. Each installer is pinned to the release that contains it:

curl -LsSf https://github.com/lgxz/dora/releases/download/v0.1.0/dora-installer.sh | sh

Run dora --version to inspect the installed version, source commit, and build date. Standalone releases that include self-update support can update themselves:

dora -update

The updater checks the latest stable GitHub Release, verifies its archive against checksums.txt, validates the downloaded executable, and replaces the current binary with rollback on failure. Go builds, manual archive installs, and package-manager installs remain unmanaged; upgrade those through their original installation method. Re-run the latest installer once to enable self-update on an older installation. Release archives and checksums remain available on the GitHub Releases page for manual installation and verification.

To replace an unmanaged or development build (for example, one installed with make install) with the latest release, bypassing the standalone-install marker and version checks:

dora -update --force

Usage:

cat AGENTS.md | dora Summarize the following content | mdcat

Build from source

Building Dora requires Go 1.25 or newer. CI checks both the minimum supported Go 1.25 line and the current Go 1.26 line; release binaries use the latest Go 1.26 patch release.

Build the command with debug information:

make build

The binary is written to build/dora (build/dora.exe on Windows). For a smaller distribution binary without symbol and DWARF debug data, use:

make release

The release target uses -trimpath, strips debug data, and embeds the version, commit, and build date. Override VERSION, COMMIT, or BUILD_DATE when needed. On Windows the equivalent Go command can be run directly with build/dora.exe as the output path when make is unavailable.

To build a release binary and install it into $(PREFIX)/bin/dora (default $HOME/.local/bin/dora), use:

make install

install depends on release and creates $(PREFIX)/bin if needed. Override PREFIX to choose another location, for example make install PREFIX=/usr/local.

API keys

Dora reads each provider's API key from a dedicated environment variable. The following table lists the supported providers, their environment variables, and their default models:

Provider Environment variable Default model
openai OPENAI_API_KEY gpt-5
deepseek DEEPSEEK_API_KEY deepseek-v4-flash
trust TRUST_API_KEY auto

Set the environment variable for the provider you want to use. The commands differ by operating system.

macOS / Linux, temporary (current terminal only):

export OPENAI_API_KEY="sk-..."

macOS / Linux, permanent: append the export line above to ~/.zshrc (zsh) or ~/.bashrc (bash), then reload it:

source ~/.zshrc

Windows PowerShell, temporary (current session only):

$env:OPENAI_API_KEY = "sk-..."

Windows PowerShell, permanent (persists for the current user):

[Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable("OPENAI_API_KEY", "sk-...", "User")

Windows CMD, temporary (current session only):

set OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-...

When you set keys for more than one provider, specify model.provider explicitly in ~/.dora/config.yaml; otherwise Dora reports an ambiguity error. Setting exactly one key lets Dora select that provider automatically.

With exactly one supported provider API key set, Dora runs without a configuration file and selects that provider automatically. For example, DEEPSEEK_API_KEY selects deepseek, OPENAI_API_KEY selects openai, and TRUST_API_KEY selects trust. If multiple provider keys are set, configure model.provider explicitly. If none are set, Dora retains deepseek as the fallback and reports that DEEPSEEK_API_KEY is missing.

To customize the defaults, create ~/.dora/config.yaml. Dora uses this ~/.dora/ layout on every operating system, including macOS. Set the DORA_HOME environment variable to an absolute path to override the home directory. You can also place the file anywhere and pass --config path/to/config.yaml; an explicitly requested file must exist.

model:
  provider: deepseek

An explicit provider always takes precedence over environment-based selection. The same automatic selection applies when a configuration file exists but omits model.provider.

The deepseek preset defaults to the chat_completions API, deepseek-v4-flash, https://api.deepseek.com, and DEEPSEEK_API_KEY. The openai preset defaults to chat_completions, gpt-5, https://api.openai.com/v1, and OPENAI_API_KEY. The trust preset defaults to chat_completions, auto, https://api.trustoken.cn/v1, and TRUST_API_KEY. Override any preset field when needed, and set api: responses to use the Responses API. Both APIs always use SSE streaming. Responses tool loops replay typed output items locally and do not depend on server-side response storage.

Third-party OpenAI-compatible providers

To use any third-party provider that speaks the OpenAI Chat Completions protocol (for example Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, Groq, Together, OpenRouter, or a self-hosted endpoint), keep model.provider: openai and override base_url, name, and api_key_env (or api_key). The Chat Completions endpoint is base_url + "/chat/completions", so base_url should be the provider's /v1 (or equivalent) root.

For a self-hosted Ollama endpoint that requires no authentication, set api_key_env: "" to disable the API key:

model:
  provider: openai
  name: llama3.1
  base_url: http://localhost:11434/v1
  api_key_env: ""

For a hosted OpenAI-compatible service that requires a key, such as OpenRouter or Groq, point api_key_env at a custom environment variable:

model:
  provider: openai
  name: openrouter/auto
  base_url: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1
  api_key_env: OPENROUTER_API_KEY

For a one-off invocation, override the model and base URL on the command line:

./dora --model llama3.1 --base-url http://localhost:11434/v1 "prompt"

Literal api_key is also supported, but an environment variable keeps secrets out of the configuration file. A non-empty literal key takes precedence over api_key_env. Set api_key_env: "" explicitly for a local endpoint that does not require authentication.

Dora runs up to 64 model-tool rounds per segment by default. Keep the safeguard but adjust it for unusually long tool workflows when needed:

agent:
  max_rounds: 96

Override it for one invocation with --max-rounds:

./dora --max-rounds 96 "Complete a long task"

When the limit is reached with both stdin and stderr attached to a terminal, Dora asks whether to continue for another segment. Confirming resumes from the completed tool output without replaying work. Declining stops normally and saves the partial state of a named session. With piped or redirected I/O, Dora does not prompt and returns dora: maximum rounds exceeded instead.

Run a one-shot prompt or combine an instruction with piped input:

export DEEPSEEK_API_KEY="..."
./dora "Explain this repository"
git diff | ./dora "Review this change"

Progress is shown on stderr with a small Dora personality, while the final answer remains on stdout. Use --quiet or -q when only the answer is wanted:

./dora --quiet "Explain this repository"

When stdout is a terminal, Dora prints the final answer as plain text. Redirected or piped stdout is identical, preserving stable output for scripts:

./dora "Write release notes"
./dora "Write release notes" > release-notes.md

Colors are enabled automatically for terminal output. Set NO_COLOR=1 to keep the layout without ANSI colors; progress remains visible on stderr.

Sessions

Use a session name to continue the same conversation across CLI invocations:

./dora -s system-status "Analyze this machine's system status"
./dora -s system-status "Continue with the busiest processes"

Start over under the same session name with --fresh. Existing history is ignored for this run and replaced only after the new task succeeds; if the run fails, the previous session remains intact:

./dora -s system-status --fresh "Analyze this machine from scratch"

Session names may contain letters, numbers, ., _, and -. Dora stores each session as a versioned JSON snapshot with 0600 permissions. Session v3 binds the configured provider, API, model, and base URL: Chat Completions resumes from messages, while Responses additionally persists its opaque typed-item continuation. Use --fresh before changing a session's backend. Version 1 and 2 session files are not supported. The default directory is ~/.dora/sessions on every operating system. Omit --session/-s to keep the existing stateless behavior. Session files can contain commands and tool output, so treat them as sensitive. Do not run two Dora processes against the same session name concurrently.

Use --config, --model, --base-url, --max-rounds, --skills-dir, or --no-skills to override the corresponding configuration for one invocation.

Skills

Skills are local instruction packages loaded by the model only when relevant. Each skill is a directory containing a SKILL.md with strict YAML front matter:

skills/
└── system-status/
    └── SKILL.md

---
name: system-status
description: Analyze CPU, memory, disk, and busy processes.
---

# System status

Inspect the machine methodically and summarize actionable findings.

By default, Dora discovers the skills directory at ~/.dora/skills (or DORA_HOME/skills), independent of the active config.yaml path. No configuration is needed.

Use skills.directories only to add more parent directories:

skills:
  directories:
    - /absolute/path/to/additional-skills

For a one-off run, add one or more parent directories on the command line:

dora --skills-dir ./project-skills --skills-dir ~/shared-skills "Run checks"

Command-line directories are merged with the default and configured directories, converted to absolute paths, and deduplicated. Use --no-skills to disable every skill source for one invocation; it takes precedence over both --skills-dir and skills.directories.

Dora advertises only skill names and descriptions in the skill tool schema. The absolute skill directory and complete SKILL.md are returned when the model calls that tool, allowing instructions to reference files such as scripts/check.sh. The skill tool never executes those files; execution still requires an enabled tool such as Bash. Names must contain lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens, and must match their directory name. Duplicate names are rejected. A missing or empty default directory simply leaves the tool disabled; malformed discovered skills and missing explicitly configured or command-line directories are errors.

Releasing

Pushing a semantic version tag runs the release workflow:

git tag v0.1.0
git push origin v0.1.0

The workflow runs the full validation, renders installers pinned to the tag, and uses GoReleaser to publish static archives for Linux, macOS, and Windows on amd64 and arm64. It also publishes checksums.txt; public repositories receive GitHub build provenance attestations. Tags that do not match semantic version syntax fail before publishing.

Command tools

Command tools use platform-aware automatic defaults: Bash is enabled on Linux and macOS, while PowerShell is enabled on Windows. The other command tool is disabled even if its executable is on PATH. Omit enabled to use that policy, or set it explicitly to override the platform default:

tools:
  bash:
    enabled: false
    timeout_seconds: 30
  powershell:
    enabled: true
    timeout_seconds: 30

Automatic tools whose executable is absent are skipped. A tool explicitly enabled with enabled: true must exist on PATH, otherwise Dora reports an error. Discovery currently checks executable presence only; it does not launch the shell to probe its runtime environment.

The Bash tool runs bash -lc in Dora's current directory. The model can use cd inside a command when it needs another directory. The tool returns exit code, stdout, stderr, timeout, and truncation information to the model as JSON. Output is limited to 1 MiB per stream. This tool grants the model the same filesystem and process permissions as the dora process, so disable it unless you trust the environment in which Dora runs.

The independent powershell tool prefers PowerShell Core (pwsh) and falls back to Windows PowerShell (powershell.exe). If both tools are explicitly enabled, they are exposed separately so their command syntaxes remain distinct.

PowerShell also starts in Dora's current directory and can use Set-Location inside a command when needed.

Both command tools accept an optional per-command timeout. It overrides the configured default for that call and cannot exceed 3600 seconds:

{
  "command": "go build ./...",
  "timeout_seconds": 300
}

When omitted, timeout_seconds comes from the corresponding YAML tool setting, or defaults to 30 seconds when that setting is zero or absent.

content_html_zh:
dora 是一个微型、模块化的 Go 语言 LLM 代理内核。 其核心是一个循环和两个接口：Model和Tool。

默认情况下，CLI 仅公开 macOS/Linux 上的 Bash 工具或 Windows 上的 PowerShell 工具；当技能目录存在时，技能工具会自动激活，没有其他工具。 CLI 从不注入系统提示符，仅将用户的提示符作为用户消息发送。 无需配置文件：设置单个提供程序 API 密钥环境变量（OpenAI、DeepSeek 或 Trustoken）可让 dora 自动选择该提供程序并立即运行。

有关模块边界、依赖项、接口和运行时流程，请参阅 docs/architecture.md。

model := newMyModel()
weather := newWeatherTool()

agent, err := dora.New(model, weather)
if err != nil {
	log.Fatal(err)
}

result, err := agent.Run(ctx, []dora.Message{
	{Role: dora.RoleUser, Content: "What's the weather?"},
})
if err != nil {
	log.Fatal(err)
}

fmt.Println(result.Content)

代理是无国籍的。 保留 result.Messages 并将其传递给稍后的呼叫以继续对话。

DoraBar 是一款适用于 dora 的 macOS 托盘/菜单栏应用程序，用 Swift 编写。 它提供了一个轻量级菜单栏界面，用于与 dora CLI 交互。

Scope

内核支持可选的模型流事件，同时保持其基线模型接口同步。 工具调用仅在当前模型响应完成后才特意执行，并且仍然是连续的。 没有内置内存、策略引擎、中间件或提供商 SDK。

CLI

安装

在 macOS 或 Linux 上，使用 curl 安装最新版本：

curl -LsSf https://github.com/lgxz/dora/releases/latest/download/dora-installer.sh | sh

当curl不可用时使用wget：

wget -qO- https://github.com/lgxz/dora/releases/latest/download/dora-installer.sh | sh

在 Windows 上，使用 PowerShell：

powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -c "irm https://github.com/lgxz/dora/releases/latest/download/dora-installer.ps1 | iex"

安装程序下载当前操作系统和架构的存档，根据发布的 SHA-256 校验和进行验证，然后默认将 dora 安装到 $HOME/.local/bin 中。 设置 DORA_INSTALL_DIR 以选择另一个目录：

curl -LsSf https://github.com/lgxz/dora/releases/latest/download/dora-installer.sh \
  | env DORA_INSTALL_DIR=/usr/local/bin sh

使用其标记的安装程序 URL 安装特定版本。 每个安装程序都固定到包含它的版本：

curl -LsSf https://github.com/lgxz/dora/releases/download/v0.1.0/dora-installer.sh | sh

运行 dora --version 来检查安装的版本、源代码提交和构建日期。 包含自我更新支持的独立版本可以自行更新：

dora -update

更新程序检查最新的稳定 GitHub 版本，根据 checksums.txt 验证其存档，验证下载的可执行文件，并在失败时回滚替换当前二进制文件。 Go 构建、手动存档安装和包管理器安装仍然不受管理；通过原始安装方法升级它们。 重新运行最新的安装程序一次，以在旧安装上启用自我更新。 版本存档和校验和仍然可以在 GitHub 版本页面上找到，以进行手动安装和验证。

要将非托管或开发版本（例如，使用 make install 安装的版本）替换为最新版本，绕过独立安装标记和版本检查：

dora -update --force

Usage:

cat AGENTS.md | dora Summarize the following content | mdcat

从源代码构建

构建 Dora 需要 Go 1.25 或更高版本。 CI 同时检查最低支持的 Go 1.25 行和当前的 Go 1.26 行；发行版二进制文件使用最新的 Go 1.26 补丁版本。

使用调试信息构建命令：

make build

二进制文件写入 build/dora（Windows 上为 build/dora.exe）。 对于没有符号和 DWARF 调试数据的较小发行版二进制文件，请使用：

make release

发布目标使用 -trimpath，剥离调试数据，并嵌入版本、提交和构建日期。 需要时覆盖 VERSION、COMMIT 或 BUILD_DATE。 在 Windows 上，当 make 不可用时，可以使用 build/dora.exe 作为输出路径直接运行等效的 Go 命令。

要构建发布二进制文件并将其安装到 $(PREFIX)/bin/dora （默认 $HOME/.local/bin/dora），请使用：

make install

install 取决于版本并根据需要创建 $(PREFIX)/bin 。 覆盖 PREFIX 以选择其他位置，例如 make install PREFIX=/usr/local。

API 密钥

Dora 从专用环境变量中读取每个提供商的 API 密钥。 下表列出了支持的提供程序、其环境变量及其默认模型：

提供者 环境变量 默认型号
开放性 OPENAI_API_KEY gpt-5
深度搜索 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY deepseek-v4-flash
trust TRUST_API_KEY auto

为您要使用的提供程序设置环境变量。 这些命令因操作系统而异。

macOS / Linux，临时（仅限当前终端）：

export OPENAI_API_KEY="sk-..."

macOS / Linux，永久：将上面的导出行附加到 ~/.zshrc (zsh) 或 ~/.bashrc (bash)，然后重新加载：

source ~/.zshrc

Windows PowerShell，临时（仅限当前会话）：

$env:OPENAI_API_KEY = "sk-..."

Windows PowerShell，永久（对当前用户持续存在）：

[Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable("OPENAI_API_KEY", "sk-...", "User")

Windows CMD，临时（仅限当前会话）：

set OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-...

当您为多个提供程序设置密钥时，请在 ~/.dora/config.yaml 中显式指定 model.provider；否则 Dora 会报告歧义错误。 精确设置一个密钥可以让 Dora 自动选择该提供商。

由于只有一个受支持的提供商 API 密钥集，Dora 无需配置文件即可运行并自动选择该提供商。 例如DEEPSEEK_API_KEY选择deepseek，OPENAI_API_KEY选择openai，TRUST_API_KEY选择信任。 如果设置了多个提供程序密钥，请显式配置 model.provider。 如果未设置，Dora 将保留 deepseek 作为后备，并报告 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 丢失。

要自定义默认值，请创建 ~/.dora/config.yaml。 Dora 在每个操作系统（包括 macOS）上都使用此 ~/.dora/ 布局。 将 DORA_HOME 环境变量设置为绝对路径以覆盖主目录。 您还可以将文件放置在任何位置并传递 --config path/to/config.yaml;明确请求的文件必须存在。

model:
  provider: deepseek

显式提供程序始终优先于基于环境的选择。 当配置文件存在但省略 model.provider 时，也会应用相同的自动选择。

deepseek 预设默认为 chat_completions API、deepseek-v4-flash、https://api.deepseek.com 和 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY。 openai 预设默认为 chat_completions、gpt-5、https://api.openai.com/v1 和 OPENAI_API_KEY。 信任预设默认为 chat_completions、auto、https://api.trustoken.cn/v1 和 TRUST_API_KEY。 需要时覆盖任何预设字段，并设置 api:response 以使用 Responses API。 这两个 API 始终使用 SSE 流。 响应工具循环在本地重播键入的输出项，并且不依赖于服务器端响应存储。

第三方 OpenAI 兼容提供商

要使用使用 OpenAI 聊天完成协议的任何第三方提供商（例如 Ollama、LM Studio、vLLM、Groq、Together、OpenRouter 或自托管端点），请保留 model.provider: openai 并覆盖 base_url、name 和 api_key_env（或 api_key）。 聊天完成端点是base_url +“/chat/completions”，因此base_url应该是提供者的/v1（或等效）根。

对于不需要身份验证的自托管 Ollama 端点，请设置 api_key_env: "" 以禁用 API 密钥：

model:
  provider: openai
  name: llama3.1
  base_url: http://localhost:11434/v1
  api_key_env: ""

对于需要密钥的托管 OpenAI 兼容服务（例如 OpenRouter 或 Groq），请将 api_key_env 指向自定义环境变量：

model:
  provider: openai
  name: openrouter/auto
  base_url: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1
  api_key_env: OPENROUTER_API_KEY

对于一次性调用，请在命令行上覆盖模型和基本 URL：

./dora --model llama3.1 --base-url http://localhost:11434/v1 "prompt"

还支持文字 api_key，但环境变量将机密保留在配置文件之外。 非空文字键优先于 api_key_env。 为不需要身份验证的本地端点显式设置 api_key_env: ""。

默认情况下，Dora 每段运行最多 64 轮模型工具。 保留防护措施，但在需要时针对异常长的工具工作流程进行调整：

agent:
  max_rounds: 96

使用 --max-rounds 覆盖一次调用：

./dora --max-rounds 96 "Complete a long task"

当连接到终端的 stdin 和 stderr 达到限制时，Dora 询问是否继续另一个段。 确认从已完成的工具输出中恢复，无需重播工作。 拒绝通常会停止并保存指定会话的部分状态。 使用管道或重定向 I/O，Dora 不会提示并返回 dora: 超过最大轮数。

运行一次性提示或将指令与管道输入结合起来：

export DEEPSEEK_API_KEY="..."
./dora "Explain this repository"
git diff | ./dora "Review this change"

进度显示在带有小 Dora 个性的 stderr 上，而最终答案仍然保留在 stdout 上。 当只需要答案时使用 --quiet 或 -q：

./dora --quiet "Explain this repository"

当 stdout 是终端时，Dora 将最终答案打印为纯文本。 重定向或管道标准输出是相同的，为脚本保留稳定的输出：

./dora "Write release notes"
./dora "Write release notes" > release-notes.md

终端输出会自动启用颜色。 设置NO_COLOR=1以保持布局没有ANSI颜色； stderr 上的进展仍然可见。

会议

使用会话名称在 CLI 调用中继续相同的对话：

./dora -s system-status "Analyze this machine's system status"
./dora -s system-status "Continue with the busiest processes"

使用 --fresh 在相同的会话名称下重新开始。 本次运行将忽略现有历史记录，仅在新任务成功后才替换；如果运行失败，前一个会话保持不变：

./dora -s system-status --fresh "Analyze this machine from scratch"

会话名称可以包含字母、数字、.、_ 和 -。 Dora 将每个会话存储为具有 0600 权限的版本化 JSON 快照。 会话 v3 绑定已配置的提供程序、API、模型和基本 URL：聊天完成从消息中恢复，而响应另外保留其不透明的类型化项目延续。 在更改会话的后端之前使用 --fresh。 不支持版本 1 和 2 会话文件。 每个操作系统上的默认目录都是 ~/.dora/sessions。 省略 --session/-s 以保留现有的无状态行为。 会话文件可以包含命令和工具输出，因此请将它们视为敏感文件。 不要同时针对同一会话名称运行两个 Dora 进程。

使用 --config、--model、--base-url、--max-rounds、--skills-dir 或 --no-skills 覆盖一次调用的相应配置。

技能

技能是模型仅在相关时加载的本地指令包。 每个技能都是一个包含 SKILL.md 的目录，其前面有严格的 YAML：

skills/
└── system-status/
    └── SKILL.md

---
name: system-status
description: Analyze CPU, memory, disk, and busy processes.
---

# System status

Inspect the machine methodically and summarize actionable findings.

默认情况下，Dora 在 ~/.dora/skills （或 DORA_HOME/skills）发现技能目录，独立于活动的 config.yaml 路径。 无需配置。

仅使用 Skills.directories 添加更多父目录：

skills:
  directories:
    - /absolute/path/to/additional-skills

对于一次性运行，请在命令行上添加一个或多个父目录：

dora --skills-dir ./project-skills --skills-dir ~/shared-skills "Run checks"

命令行目录与默认目录和配置目录合并，转换为绝对路径，并进行重复数据删除。 使用 --no-skills 禁用一次调用的每个技能源；它优先于 --skills-dir 和 Skills.directories。

Dora 仅在技能工具架构中公布技能名称和描述。 当模型调用该工具时，会返回绝对技能目录和完整的 SKILL.md，从而允许指令引用 script/check.sh 等文件。 技能工具从不执行这些文件；执行仍然需要启用的工具，例如 Bash。 名称必须包含小写字母、数字和连字符，并且必须与其目录名称匹配。 重复的名称将被拒绝。 默认目录缺失或为空只会导致该工具被禁用；发现的技能格式错误以及缺少显式配置或命令行目录均属于错误。

释放

推送语义版本标签运行发布工作流程：

git tag v0.1.0
git push origin v0.1.0

该工作流程运行完整的验证，呈现固定到标签的安装程序，并使用 GoReleaser 在 amd64 和 arm64 上发布适用于 Linux、macOS 和 Windows 的静态存档。 它还发布了 checksums.txt；公共存储库接收 GitHub 构建来源证明。 与语义版本语法不匹配的标签在发布之前会失败。

命令工具

命令工具使用平台感知的自动默认设置：在 Linux 和 macOS 上启用 Bash，在 Windows 上启用 PowerShell。 即使另一个命令工具的可执行文件位于 PATH 上，它也会被禁用。 忽略启用该策略，或显式设置它以覆盖平台默认值：

tools:
  bash:
    enabled: false
    timeout_seconds: 30
  powershell:
    enabled: true
    timeout_seconds: 30

不存在可执行文件的自动工具将被跳过。 使用enabled: true显式启用的工具必须存在于PATH中，否则Dora会报告错误。 Discovery 目前仅检查可执行文件是否存在；它不会启动 shell 来探测其运行时环境。

Bash 工具在 Dora 的当前目录中运行 bash -lc。 当模型需要另一个目录时，可以在命令中使用 cd 。 该工具以 JSON 形式将退出代码、stdout、stderr、超时和截断信息返回到模型。 每个流的输出限制为 1 MiB。 该工具向模型授予与 dora 进程相同的文件系统和进程权限，因此除非您信任 Dora 运行的环境，否则请禁用它。

独立的 powershell 工具更喜欢 PowerShell Core (pwsh)，并回退到 Windows PowerShell (powershell.exe)。 如果显式启用这两个工具，它们将单独公开，因此它们的命令语法保持不同。

PowerShell 也会在 Dora 的当前目录中启动，并且可以在需要时在命令中使用 Set-Location。

两种命令工具都接受可选的每命令超时。 它会覆盖该调用的默认配置，并且不能超过 3600 秒：

{
  "command": "go build ./...",
  "timeout_seconds": 300
}

如果省略，timeout_seconds 来自相应的 YAML 工具设置，或者当该设置为零或不存在时默认为 30 秒。
